tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the MemorySync documentation and return matching pages with their headings and a link to the full Markdown text.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read the full Markdown text of one documentation page. Prefer this over a search snippet when you need exact method names, parameters, fields or limits.

tools.name: list_doc_sections
tools.description: List the top-level documentation sections and how many pages each contains, to orient before searching.
